logical_spool: Stats.chargeable_bytes is the union of ordinary-spool source coverage, clipped to each source highwater. Fresh4B charges4; a surviving middle1B lease in a larger source charges its4KiB block; overlapping tokens and retained metadata references do not double charge. write_from is ordinary; write_inline_from uses the same physical pipeline but immutable source flag false. Ordinary append refuses an inline source before reading input. Physical/live block accounting includes both classes.
private_source_record_change: SOURCE row expands from16 to24bytes: highwater, token-owner count, immutable ordinary-spool flag. There is no restart/private-format compatibility claim; anonymous runtime state is freshly constructed.
sync_contract: Old Workspace test fsync checked/observed segments; LiveOwner flushed append/facts and CHECK only observed highwater/metrics. New explicit sync_data calls actual data/catalog and both arena descriptors, propagates I/O errors, and performs no graph/owner drain. Index File fields are Arc<File> so2 handles can be retained under a short storage lock then synced after the lock releases, without dup/new fds. Root/install locks are not held. Runtime-private unlinked arenas and in-memory roots are not a crash-recoverable Workspace; this does not publish a branch or implement snapshot acquisition.
